name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who feels it?

## Proposed solution

How would you like to solve it? Sketch the API, UI, or behavior if you can.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why this one is better.

## Scope

Does the change require new dependencies, a schema change, a new agent, or a UI change? Approximate effort: small (under a day), medium (a few days), large (more than a week).

## Additional context

Links, references, prior art.
